text:
sophie: quick heads-up — during onboarding test of the sampleapp (node) I hit a rerank failure. embeddings come back as nested arrays instead of flat vectors, so our reranker asserts on shape.

dylan: which endpoint / SDK version? can you paste the response you saw?

sophie: node SDK 0.8.3 against staging. response snippet: ```json
{"id":"e_123","object":"embedding","embedding":[[0.0123,0.0045, -0.0034, ... ]],"model":"open-embed-1536"}
```

maria: ugh that's the old helper wrapping single-item batches. _normalizeEmbeddings wraps single embeddings in an outer array when batchSize === 1. I thought we patched that last month but maybe regen missed node.

dylan: interesting — did you call the batching helper or raw client?

sophie: sampleapp uses the batching helper to be friendly to new users. config was default (batchSize: 1) so it went through the helper path.

jen: another wrinkle I noticed yesterday: if the auth token refresh fires mid-request the retry path replays the original payload but drops the `X-Model` header in the node client; downstream we then pick a fallback model which returns different vector dims. combined with the wrapper bug you get both nesting + wrong dim -> loud failure.

sam: ok that explains the confidence interval mismatch. repro steps I used: 1) set batchSize=1 in sampleapp, 2) force token expire (shorten env TOKEN_TTL), 3) send rerank request with 1 candidate. Failure is consistent.

maria: plan: I will push a small patch in node SDK to a) always flatten embeddings in the client response, b) make the batching helper return consistent shapes regardless of batch size. also add a regression test for the token-refresh+retry path that validates headers are preserved.

dylan: thanks. can you also add an opt-in env var SAMPLEAPP_EMBED_FLATTEN=true so we can hotfix onboarding containers until the SDK patch ships? less churn.

maria: yes will do. will also log an audit event when token refresh happens so we can correlate retries in staging.

sophie: temporary mitigation for folks onboarding: in node sampleapp set `batching: {batchSize: 2}` or use `embeddingsFlatten: true` in config. adding note to quickstart README now.

jen: FYI I opened a small issue for the header-drop bug: https://git.redwood/contrib/node-sdk/issues/482 (contains reproducer).

deploy-bot: patch node-sdk@main (normalize-embeddings-fix) deployed to staging (build #4382) :rocket:

maria: I'll follow up with a PR to sampleapp to update default config and a release candidate for the SDK. thanks for the speedy triage :thumbsup:

sophie: tests pass locally, will smoke test staging in ~15m and report back. thank you all!
